help.title: SIF Help Center
help.subtitle: Step-by-step guides for managing patients, appointments and nutrition plans
help.no_results_desc: We couldn't find help matching your search. Try using different keywords.

dashboard_overview.title: Dashboard Overview
dashboard_overview.description: Learn how to navigate your SIF dashboard and access all your management tools.
steps: Log in with your SIF account
The main dashboard displays widgets with key clinic statistics
View your appointment calendar, recent revenue, and pending patients
Click any widget to access specific details

navigation_basics.title: Navigation Basics
navigation_basics.description: Master the side menu and quickly access all main sections.
steps: Locate the left sidebar with navigation icons
Each icon represents a section: Patients, Appointments, Nutrition, etc.
Click an icon to expand the menu and see subcategories
Use the hamburger button to collapse/expand menu and gain screen space

user_profile.title: Manage Your User Profile
user_profile.description: Access and edit your personal information, profile picture, and contact details.
steps: Click your avatar or name in the top right corner
Select 'My Profile' from the dropdown menu
Edit your name, email, phone, and profile photo

tenant_switching.title: Switch Between Clinics (Tenants)
tenant_switching.description: Easily switch between different clinics or practices where you work.
steps: If you have access to multiple clinics, you'll see a selector in the top menu
Select the clinic you want to switch to
The application will reload with the new clinic's context

role_based_access.title: Understand Role-Based Access Control
role_based_access.description: Learn what features are available based on your role in the clinic.
steps: Each user has an assigned role (Owner, Admin, Nutritionist, etc.)
Your role determines which sections and features you can access
Users with limited permissions will see fewer menu options
If you need to access a blocked feature, contact your clinic administrator

notifications_alerts.title: Manage Notifications and Alerts
notifications_alerts.description: Configure and control notifications for appointments, messages, and updates.
steps: Click the bell icon in the top bar
Click any notification to go to the related item
Go to Settings > Notifications to customize which alerts you receive

search_filters.title: Use Search and Advanced Filters
search_filters.description: Quickly find patients, appointments, and other data using search and filters.
steps: Use the quick search bar at the top for global results
In lists (Patients, Appointments, etc.), use the specific 'Search' field
Apply additional filters like date range, status, specialty
Combine multiple filters to refine your results

settings_overview.title: Settings Overview
settings_overview.description: Access all configuration options to personalize your experience.
steps: Click the gear icon in the top right corner
Navigate between tabs: Account, Notifications, Privacy, Clinic
Make changes and save by clicking 'Save'

password_security.title: Change Password and Security
password_security.description: Keep your account secure by updating your password regularly.
steps: Enter and confirm your new password

language_preferences.title: Change Language and Preferences
language_preferences.description: Set your interface language according to your preference.
steps: Click the language icon in the top right corner

patient_management.title: Basic Patient Management
patient_management.description: Create, edit, and organize your patient records.
steps: Go to Patients in the main menu
Click '+ New Patient' to create one
Complete personal data: name, age, gender, contact
Add allergies, medical conditions, and current medications

patient_advanced_search.title: Advanced Patient Search
patient_advanced_search.description: Find specific patients using multiple search criteria.
steps: In the Patients list, open the 'Advanced Filters' panel
Search by name, email, phone, or ID number
Filter by age range, gender, subscription status
Filter by creation date or last appointment
Save frequently used filters for reuse

patient_import.title: Bulk Import Patients
patient_import.description: Upload multiple patients from a CSV file.
steps: Fill the file with your patients' data
Upload the file using the 'Select File' button

staff_management.title: Manage Your Clinic Staff
staff_management.description: Add and manage nutritionists and other clinic staff.
steps: Enter email and select role (Nutritionist, Admin, etc.)
Member will accept invitation and join the team

staff_permissions.title: Configure Staff Permissions
staff_permissions.description: Control what functions each team member can perform.
steps: Click on a member to edit their profile
Options include: View Patients, Create Appointments, Manage Menus, etc.

appointments_calendar.title: Use the Appointment Calendar
appointments_calendar.description: View, create, and manage appointments in the interactive calendar.
steps: Switch between views: Day, Week, Month
Click a time slot to create a new appointment
Select patient, appointment type, and duration
Save the appointment to the calendar

appointments_creation.title: Create and Schedule Appointments
appointments_creation.description: Schedule appointments with your patients by setting date, time, and details.
steps: Select an existing patient or create a new one
Choose appointment date, time, and duration

appointments_confirmation.title: Confirm and Remind Appointments
appointments_confirmation.description: Send automatic confirmations and reminders to your patients.
steps: In Appointments, open an upcoming appointment
Set reminder type (24h before, 2h before, etc.)
The system will send automatic notifications to the patient

revenue_dashboard.title: View Revenue Dashboard
revenue_dashboard.description: Monitor total revenue, earnings per patient, and trends.
steps: Go to Revenue in the main menu
View the revenue chart for the current period
See breakdown by service type (nutrition, follow-up, etc.)
Filter by date range to see trends
Download reports in PDF or Excel

revenue_tracking.title: Track Payments and Invoices
revenue_tracking.description: Record and monitor patient payments and issue invoices.
steps: Set amount, taxes, and payment terms
Send invoice to patient or download as PDF

revenue_analytics.title: Analyze Revenue and Profitability
revenue_analytics.description: Get insights into your financial performance and most profitable patients.
steps: Identify patients with highest lifetime value

menus_creation.title: Create and Design Nutrition Menus
menus_creation.description: Design personalized menus for your patients based on their goals.
steps: Select type (Weight Loss, Muscle Gain, Maintenance, etc.)
Add daily meals from the recipe library

menus_templates.title: Use Menu Templates
menus_templates.description: Speed up menu creation using pre-designed templates.
steps: Click 'Duplicate' to create a customizable copy
Save as new template or assign to a patient

menus_assignment.title: Assign Menus to Patients
menus_assignment.description: Deliver created menus to your patients for them to follow.
steps: Create or select an existing menu
Select the patient and start date
Patient will receive menu in their dashboard

menus_macro_tracking.title: Track Macronutrients and Calories
menus_macro_tracking.description: Monitor that menus meet nutritional goals.
steps: In Nutrition > Menus, open a menu
View breakdown of calories and macronutrients
System automatically calculates totals per meal/day
Adjust portions if needed to reach specific goals

shopping_lists_creation.title: Create Shopping Lists
shopping_lists_creation.description: Generate shopping lists based on menus to ease grocery shopping.
steps: Select a menu or create a custom list
Save or export list as PDF

shopping_lists_management.title: Organize and Manage Shopping Lists
shopping_lists_management.description: Reorganize ingredients, group by aisle, and share with patients.
steps: Check off ingredients as you shop
Group ingredients by category (Fruits, Proteins, etc.)
Add or remove items as needed
Share list with patient via link

shopping_lists_export.title: Export and Share Shopping Lists
shopping_lists_export.description: Download lists as PDF or share digitally with your patients.
steps: Or use 'Share' to send a link to the patient
Patient will receive a read-only version

templates_nutrition.title: Create Custom Nutrition Templates
templates_nutrition.description: Design reusable templates for specific cases.
steps: Save for use in future menus

templates_plans.title: Nutrition Plan Templates
templates_plans.description: Create reusable nutrition plans for common goals.
steps: Structure week by week (what changes each week)
Save as template to assign to new patients

templates_management.title: Manage and Update Templates
templates_management.description: Keep your templates organized, updated, and easy to find.
steps: Click a template to edit content
Use tags to categorize (Vegetarian, Low Carb, etc.)
Mark most-used as favorites for quick access

settings_clinic.title: Configure Clinic Information
settings_clinic.description: Customize your clinic's name, logo, and main data.
steps: Edit official name and short name
Upload logo in PNG or JPG format (recommended 512x512px)
Enter address, phone, and contact email

settings_branding.title: Customize Brand and Appearance
settings_branding.description: Apply custom colors and styles to your clinic.
steps: Choose between light or dark theme
Save to apply throughout the platform

settings_notifications.title: Configure Automatic Notifications
settings_notifications.description: Customize which notifications you and your patients receive.
steps: Options: New Patients, Upcoming Appointments, Payments Received, etc.

settings_integrations.title: Connect External Integrations
settings_integrations.description: Link external applications like Google Calendar, Stripe, etc.
steps: Select the integration you want to enable
Authorize SIF to access your external account

reports_generation.title: Generate Progress Reports
reports_generation.description: Create detailed reports of your patients' progress.
steps: Select type: Patient Progress, Nutrition, Appointments, etc.

reports_export.title: Export Data in Multiple Formats
reports_export.description: Download data in PDF, Excel, or CSV for external analysis.
steps: In any list (Patients, Appointments, Revenue), click 'Export'
Select desired format: PDF, Excel, or CSV

nutrition_plans_basics.title: Create Basic Nutrition Plans
nutrition_plans_basics.description: Design personalized nutrition plans for specific goals.
steps: Select type (Weight Loss, Gain, Maintenance, Performance)
Create or assign menus for each week

nutrition_plans_advanced.title: Advanced Nutrition Plans and Personalization
nutrition_plans_advanced.description: Adjust plans based on biochemical analysis and specific results.
steps: Open an existing plan to edit
Establish 'refeed days' if plan includes variations

patient_dashboard_basics.title: Understand Your Patient Dashboard
patient_dashboard_basics.description: Learn the main widgets and navigate your patient zone.
steps: Your dashboard shows summary of upcoming appointments
View active menus assigned to you

patient_profile_management.title: Manage Your Patient Profile
patient_profile_management.description: Update your personal information and preferences.
steps: Click your avatar in the top right corner
Edit name, email, phone, and photo

patient_menus_view.title: View and Follow Your Menus
patient_menus_view.description: Access menus assigned by your nutritionist.
steps: Open a menu to see meal details

patient_nutrition_plans.title: Follow Your Nutrition Plan
patient_nutrition_plans.description: Monitor your progress and assigned nutrition goals.
steps: See weekly breakdown of expected changes

patient_shopping_lists.title: Access Shared Shopping Lists
patient_shopping_lists.description: Use shopping lists shared by your nutritionist.
steps: Open lists shared by your nutritionist
Check off items as you shop

patient_recipes.title: Explore Recipes and Preparation
patient_recipes.description: Access recipes with step-by-step instructions and ingredients.
steps: Open a recipe to see detailed instructions
Mark as favorite for quick access

patient_hydration_tracking.title: Track Your Water Intake
patient_hydration_tracking.description: Record daily water consumption and hydration.
steps: Enter amount of water consumed (in cups or ml)
System shows visual progress for the day

patient_measurements.title: Record Body Measurements
patient_measurements.description: Document weight, measurements, and physical analysis for tracking.
steps: Enter weight, height, and circumferences (waist, hips, etc.)
Record body fat percentage if available

patient_appointment_booking.title: Book Available Appointments
patient_appointment_booking.description: Select and book available appointments with your nutritionist.
steps: Go to 'My Appointments' in your dashboard

patient_appointment_history.title: View Appointment History
patient_appointment_history.description: Review all past appointments, notes, and recommendations.
steps: View completed appointments in chronological order
Click an appointment to see your nutritionist's notes

nutri_patient_overview.title: Patient Panel (Nutritionist View)
nutri_patient_overview.description: Access complete patient information in a single view.
steps: Go to Patients > select a patient
View profile: personal data, allergies, medications
See appointment history, assigned menus, and progress
Access body measurements and historical tracking

nutri_progress_tracking.title: Track Patient Progress
nutri_progress_tracking.description: Monitor your patients' advancement toward their goals.
steps: View charts of weight, measurements, and tracking
Generate progress reports to share with patient

nutri_meal_recommendations.title: Make Meal Recommendations
nutri_meal_recommendations.description: Provide personalized suggestions based on preferences.
steps: Filter by allergies, preferences, and meal type
Review options in the recipe library
Click to add meal to patient's menu
Meal is added with automatic macronutrient calculation

nutri_education_resources.title: Share Educational Resources
nutri_education_resources.description: Send guides, articles, and videos to your patients.
steps: Select articles, videos, or guides available
